title: Sexy Parodius
native_title: セクシー・パロディウス
overview:
This Time, Parodius Is "Sexy"!

The hit that swept the arcades into a whirlpool of laughter and sensuality finally arrives on the SS!!

The Parodius Army has opened a detective agency!! We'll solve any case, and we'll take a generous fee for it. Rake in the money, and with a pretty lady... heh heh. No, no, of course it's all for the peace of the entire universe. Yes.

This side-scrolling gag shooter sends you through bizarre, colorful stages full of oddball enemies and bosses. Each stage gives you a mission, such as shooting down a set number of enemies or collecting coins, and whether you succeed decides which stage comes next and which version of the ending demo you see.

- Pilots include Vic Viper, the penguins Ivan and Toby, the bunny girls Hikaru and Akane, and more, each with their own power-ups
- Two players can fly together at the same time, with combined attacks that depend on the pair
- A bonus stage plays like a fighting-game shooter against a parade of bosses

こんどのパロディウスは「セクシー」だ!

アーケードを爆笑と官能の渦に巻き込んだ話題作、ついにSSに登場!!

パロディウス軍団、探偵事務所設立!!
どんな事件も解決しまっせ、お礼もはずんでもらいまっせ。
がっぽり儲けて、キレイなおね~ちゃんと♥・・・ムフフ
イエイエ、もちろん全宇宙の平和のためです。ハイ。
